purpose: detect outages from outside the system as a user would, and notify the right people with a trustworthy status
entry_criteria: Public and critical endpoints are listed
A monitoring service reaching from outside exists
An on-call and status process exists
procedure: Probe each critical endpoint from several regions outside your network, checking status code, response content and latency, not only that the port is open.
Add checks for the full journey where possible, such as sign-in and a read operation, using a dedicated test account.
Require several consecutive failures from more than one location before alerting, to avoid false alarms from single probe faults.
Page the on-call person with the endpoint, region and first failing time, and update the status page from a verified fault.
Also monitor the monitor: a second independent checker or a heartbeat that fires when probes stop reporting.
Calculate uptime from probe data with a stated method, and review misses and false alarms monthly.
acceptance_criteria: Probes run from several outside locations
Uptime states how it is calculated

validation.command: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n' https://app.example.com/health   # example from outside the network
validation.expect: expected code within the latency target

validation.check: block the endpoint in staging for five minutes
validation.expect: alert fires after the confirmation count and the status process is followed

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Three regions probe the sign-in journey every minute; two consecutive failures from two regions page on-call, and a dead-man heartbeat from the probe service alerts if reports stop for five minutes.
